statement_map.email_excerpt: I know this has been frustrating, and I'm sorry for the trouble.
You wanted help with lesson videos that keep loading and never play for some of your students, mostly on their phones.
We opened the lesson link you shared on Chrome, Safari and a phone, and the video played fine each time, so we could not reproduce the problem from our side.
Ask one affected student to record a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link.
We will raise this with our technical team and get back to you.
We are not able to confirm a timeline yet.
